eatingOutPriceLevel.basis: Price level of restaurants and hotels relative to Finland, World Bank International Comparison Program 2021.
eatingOutPriceLevel.limitations: The programme prices restaurants and hotels together, so hotel prices are part of this figure.

coldestMonthMean.basis: Average temperature of the coldest month, Toronto (The Annex), climate normals 1991-2020.

warmestMonthMeanMax.basis: Average daily high of the warmest month, Toronto (The Annex), climate normals 1991-2020.

decemberDaylight.basis: Sunrise to sunset on 21 December at latitude 43.65°, calculated.

foreignBornShare.basis: Immigrants (people born outside Canada) as a share of Toronto's population, 2021 census: 1,286,140 people (Statistics Canada, via Wikipedia).

cityWide.basis: Average asking rents in the city of Toronto, October 2026 (Door Insight, as reported by Moving2Canada): one bedroom $2,262, two $2,930, three $3,674; the Rentals.ca and Urbanation report for August 2026 agrees ($2,939 and $3,642 for two and three bedrooms).
cityWide.limitations: An unverified estimate from listing-site reports read through republications. Asking rents for vacant units; utilities, parking and tenant insurance are often extra. To be checked against the original reports or CMHC before 1.0.

1.basis: Electricity, heating and water, from published averages: Expatistan gives C$198 a month for two people in an 85 m² flat (about 2.30 per m²) and C$134 for one person in a 45 m² studio (about 3.00 per m²); livingcost.org gives about US$84 (about C$119) for one person, about 2.60 per m² in a 45 m² flat. 2.6 per m² a month × 50 m², the app's assumed size for 1 bedroom.
1.limitations: An unverified estimate from crowd-sourced averages over the year; many Toronto rents include heat or water, so this can count something the rent already covers. To be checked before 1.0.

transitPassAdult.basis: TTC adult fare of $3.30 with PRESTO for 44 rides a month; since 31 August 2026 fares are capped after 47 rides a month ($155.10), which replaced the monthly pass.
transitPassAdult.limitations: Assumes two rides a working day.

healthcarePerPerson.basis: Out-of-pocket health spending per person in Canada (US$974.38 in 2024, World Bank) at the 2024 average exchange rate (1.3694 dollars per US dollar).
healthcarePerPerson.limitations: A national average. Doctors and hospitals are covered by OHIP; dental care, prescriptions and eyewear are often paid privately or through an employer plan.

carMonthly.basis: WealthNorth (2026): a new mid-size sedan at $40,000 costs about $15,445 in its first year: depreciation $8,000, loan interest $1,470, insurance $2,100, fuel $2,475, maintenance $1,200 and licensing $200.
carMonthly.limitations: An unverified single claim for a mid-size sedan in its first year, when depreciation is highest; a compact car costs less. To be checked before 1.0.

carRunningMonthly.basis: What remains once the car is paid for: insurance, fuel, maintenance and licensing, $5,975 a year, about $498 a month. Ontario no longer charges for plate renewal.
carRunningMonthly.limitations: An unverified single claim for a mid-size sedan in its first year, when depreciation is highest; a compact car costs less. To be checked before 1.0.

groceriesPerAdultEquivalent.basis: Average spending in Finland on food and drink at home, €362 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: 1.63 CAD for each euro spent in Finland.
groceriesPerAdultEquivalent.limitations: Price levels from the 2021 international comparison, moved to 2024 with overall inflation; national prices, so the city itself may differ.

communicationsPerAdultEquivalent.basis: Average spending in Finland on phone and internet (services and devices), €70 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: 3.66 CAD for each euro spent in Finland.
communicationsPerAdultEquivalent.limitations: Price levels from the 2021 international comparison, moved to 2024 with overall inflation; national prices, so the city itself may differ.

eatingOut.basis: Average spending in Finland on eating out and hotels, €196 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: 1.28 CAD for each euro spent in Finland.
eatingOut.limitations: Price levels from the 2021 international comparison, moved to 2024 with overall inflation; national prices, so the city itself may differ.

recreation.basis: Average spending in Finland on leisure and holidays, €251 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: 1.25 CAD for each euro spent in Finland.
recreation.limitations: Price levels from the 2021 international comparison, moved to 2024 with overall inflation; national prices, so the city itself may differ.
